R101.note: getHost()/isAbsolute() checks correctly reject external hosts, protocol-relative URIs, and opaque schemes (javascript:, data:) while still allowing relative paths through.

R102.note: Adds explicit AuthorizeAsync check consistent with the original Admin role gate; write-up openly supplies the AdminOnly policy definition the check depends on.

R103.note: Uses the genuine JNDI DirContext.search(name, filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) overload, which RFC-4515-escapes the argument and preserves default search scope via an explicit new SearchControls().

R104.note: Regex allowlist fully closes the traversal vector; the accompanying path.relative double-negation check is confusing dead code but harmless and doesn't change behavior.

R105.note: allowed_classes restriction is the correct PHP mitigation; ShoppingCart still deserializes normally and the existing instanceof fallback still handles rejected payloads.

R106.note: Controller-side allowlist matches the stated contract exactly: tenantId stays bound, created_at default is preserved, and allowlisted sorts still return rows.

R107.note: POST + ValidateAntiForgeryToken fully closes the CSRF vector, but the sample confirmation form omits a hidden field/value for the required 'confirmed' parameter, so a legitimate submit would bind confirmed=false and redirect back instead of deleting -- an undisclosed functional regression.

R108.note: Adds requireRole('admin') to match every sibling admin route exactly; no other behavior changed.

R109.note: Fixed code reads message.UserId, but ChatMessage only declares AuthorUserId -- this will not compile.

R110.note: Character allowlist correctly blocks LDAP metacharacters, but the added 3-64 length bound is an undisclosed extra restriction that could reject legitimate short sAMAccountNames.

R111.note: snprintf rewrite matches the stated contract precisely: identical 'AUDIT user:action' output when inputs fit, oversized input cleanly rejected with -1 instead of overflowing.

R112.note: Standard htmlspecialchars encoding closes the XSS sink without altering legitimate note rendering.

R113.note: Hardcoded-method option drops the required default created_at sort (violates the stated contract) and changes findForTenant's signature without updating InvoiceService/Controller, which still call the old two-arg method -- breaks compilation; the 'alternative' option is an unintegrated fragment.

R114.note: archive/tar removes the shell sink and matches the contract's status codes/format, but archive/tar.NewReader can't parse gzip-compressed tar files the original shelled-out 'tar -tf' would auto-detect -- an undisclosed regression for compressed archives.

R115.note: Correctly sources the stored extension from the already-computed detected.ext instead of the client-supplied name, with no other behavior change.

R116.note: Replacing Process.Start/PowerShell with System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping removes the shell sink, but the success/timeout responses fabricate hardcoded 'bytes=32'/'TTL=64' values not derived from the real reply, and introduce new 400/503 status codes absent from the original, none of it flagged as a behavior change.

R117.note: finfo-based content sniffing plus random server-side filename and allowlisted extension closes the mismatched-extension vector; the filename randomization is disclosed as intentional.
